Abstract:

This talk explores the pivotal role of the mining sector in shaping India’s economic growth, powering industrial development, generating employment, and strengthening infrastructure. It also highlights the opportunities and challenges in building a sustainable, responsible, and technology-driven mining industry to support India’s vision of a developed nation
